text:
sam.durand: Quick heads-up — BrightPath (SI) + AuroraHW asked for a live joint demo: Delta Share -> vector DB (Qdrant) streaming prototype next Wed. They want hardware on-site + Redwood Dedicated pool. Who can own infra provisioning and runbook?
elaine_park: I can take infra. Need the exact HW spec from AuroraHW and a capacity estimate (qps, concurrent streams).
vikram.k: AuroraHW confirmed DGX-A100 4x per rack. BrightPath wants sustained 200 qps with bursts to 500 for demo. Dedicated makes sense.
maria_cs: I'll own invites, runbook, and the script for the partner demo flow. Can we lock the data slice? we should avoid PII.
sam.durand: Good — use sanitized ecom dataset (10M rows sample). Flow: Delta Share -> CDC -> transform -> embedding -> Qdrant upsert. Perf goal: end-to-end ingest+index < 30s for a 10k batch, and single-query p95 < 250ms.
elaine_park: Notes for infra: we need private VPC peering with partner network, reserved Dedicated pool called `partner-demo-aurora`, and ephemeral S3 for staging. Also set up per-route tracing in Console.
vikram.k: SDK/connector work: BrightPath will wire Delta Share streaming to our connector. We need a connector config example. Maria, include this in the runbook:
```
connector:
  source: delta_share
  sink: qdrant
  batch_size: 10000
  transform: normalize_text -> embed-openai-ada
  retries: 3
```
maria_cs: perfect. i'll add step-by-step, expected logs, and RT troubleshooting checklist.
sam.durand: Who will own model & quantization profile for embeddings? We should pick a fast embedder to meet latency.
vikram.k: Recommend using smaller on-device embed model (r:open-embed-384-q8) on Dedicated pool. We'll test accuracy vs latency.
elaine_park: Deploy plan: provision pool (2 nodes to start, scale to 5 if burst). Set autoscale policy: cpu < 60% keep, burst up to 8. Also enable KV prefix cache for repeated queries.
deploy-bot: Reminder: reserved pool name must match infra tag `partner-demo-aurora` to attach SLA. Use infra-ticket #PRT-4721 for provisioning.
maria_cs: Timeline check — we have 5 working days. Elaine/vikram can you confirm provisioning + connector test by EOD Friday? I'll schedule rehearsal on Tuesday.
elaine_park: Confirmed. I'll open PRT-4721 and attach networking tasks. ETA: Friday EOD for base infra. :thumbsup:
vikram.k: I'll have connector + embed tests by Friday. Won't have full perf numbers until we stage on Aurora nodes but should be close.
sam.durand: Great — Maria, please include rollback steps (point demo traffic to hosted fallback model and toggled A/B flag) in the runbook. Also ensure legal has the partner NDA snippet for data sharing.
maria_cs: Will do. Adding rollback + compliance checklist now.
sam.durand: Thanks team. I'll sync with BrightPath and AuroraHW and post partner-facing runbook draft by tomorrow. :rocket:
